# ROADMAP: Engine 13.4 replaces the shipped 13.3 section

**Updated 2026-11-06, operator direction:** 13.4 is householding, reducing the backlog as far as possible, and the next release is undecided. The Fix and AC-1 below reflect it.

## Context

Engine 13.3.0 shipped on 2026-10-21 and 13.3.1 on 2026-10-23. All three 13.3 cornerstones closed: #19658, #19643 and #19637.

`ROADMAP.md`, last changed on 2026-10-12, still opens with `## Next: Engine 13.3` and points session intake at milestone #11. On 2026-11-05 @neo-gemini-maryam closed the shipped milestones #8, #9, #11 and #12 and created v13.4 (#13), which holds no items yet.

The release cadence the roadmap promises is one to two weeks, and two weeks have passed since 13.3.1. The `update-roadmap` beat opened on 2026-11-05: the release was celebrated and the option space broadcast. Maryam proposed a thesis and cornerstones, and her peer-role read found three of the four candidates already finished or nearly so (see the table in The Fix).

## The Problem

The file every session starts from describes a release that has shipped, and no 13.4 scope exists.

## The Architectural Reality

`ROADMAP.md` keeps the release lines' table and riders at file level. `## Next: Engine 13.3` holds:
- the gate sentence and a milestone pointer;
- the cornerstone table (anchor, steward, done signal);
- what is carried in the milestone, and what runs beside the gate;
- **How it runs**;
- the deferred list;
- **Session intake**.

The `update-roadmap` skill governs the beat: replace the section, never append; name cornerstones with their rationale and let the milestone hold the full set; keep a visible deferred set; stewards self-select. #19642 is the precedent rewrite (13.2 → 13.3).

Design authority: the `update-roadmap` workflow ("a roadmap is cornerstones + rationale … each run REPLACES the prior next-scope"), with the operator's 2026-11-06 direction setting 13.4 as householding.

## The Fix

1. Replace `## Next: Engine 13.3` with `## Next: Engine 13.4`, carrying:
   - a one-sentence gate in observable terms and a short thesis: 13.4 is householding, reducing the backlog as far as possible;
   - the in-flight epic table below, each row with its done signal;
   - the carried items: grid column group headers (#20379) and opt-in closable tabs (#26), plus what joins the milestone later;
   - **How it runs**: cut by `publish.mjs` at the end of the window (about 2026-11-19), or earlier once the householding and the in-flight epics are done;
   - the deferred set: the rest of Grid Multi-Body (#9486), the full worker boundary, the middleware SSR rebuild (#12964) and Pointer Events for the drag sensors (#17889);
   - session intake pointing at milestone #13.
2. Point the shipped-history line at the 13.3.1 release.
3. Attach each in-flight epic to milestone #13.

| Epic | Anchor | Steward (self-selected) | State at filing |
|---|---|---|---|
| CI runs each tier only when a change can reach it | #20328 | Grace | 7/8 subs closed |
| The single-app Neural Link specs run in hosted CI without a Bridge | #20370 | Vega | 3/6 subs closed |
| An outside coding agent gets neo in one command | #20114 | Grace | 14/14 subs closed; owes its epic close-out |

The Brain-gated e2e tier on every Engine PR (#19655) closed as completed on 2026-11-05, so it is not an in-flight epic.

Decision Record impact: `none`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `ROADMAP.md`'s `## Next` section names Engine 13.4, with a gate sentence, a thesis, the in-flight epic table (anchor, steward, done signal), the carried items, **How it runs**, a deferred set and session intake to milestone #13. No 13.3 section remains.
- [ ] AC-2: the shipped-history line points at 13.3.1.
- [ ] AC-3: #20328, #20370 and #20114 are attached to milestone #13.
- [ ] AC-4: the file-level line table and its riders are unchanged.

## Out of Scope

- Cutting 13.4 (`publish.mjs`, release notes).
- Scheduling anything beyond 13.4: the next release is undecided (operator, 2026-11-06).
